_meta.note: These are NOT fetched live. Every entry carries verified_on. When you update a line, update its date. Entries belong here ONLY when no feed exists. Oct 1 2026: Rangers, Scotland rugby, Raiders, Goldeneyes and the Canucks moved to live feeds. Oct 2 2026: the Warriors moved to a hardcoded schedule array in forge_actions.py (poster-sourced, no feed exists anywhere), so teams is now empty and only the fighters remain hand-kept — because no fighter-level feed exists.
